review: Independent SOPS ordinary correctness and end-to-end opt-in review
scope: All 28 changed files and surrounding view, lifecycle, profile, staging, bounded-process and Git reader paths. Ordinary correctness only; no security scan or old-head probe.

findings.title: Binary-envelope heuristic rejects valid structured JSON and decodes binary .json files with the wrong store
findings.static_trace: inspect treats every parseable JSON envelope containing only data+sops as Binary when its path does not end .json, and always Json when it does end .json. compare passes this guessed format to tool::decrypt, whose input and output store types both use that format. No opt-in format selector or ambiguity fallback exists.
confirmed_cases: A legitimate SOPS structured JSON document with plaintext {data:42}, stored at an extensionless encrypted-config path (or .yaml), has exactly data+sops keys. Source routes it to Binary; official SOPS3.10.0's binary decoder exits 4, whereas its JSON decoder successfully returns the original structured JSON. Show decrypted therefore fails despite valid data and keys.

A SOPS binary envelope containing dummy fixture NUL bytes, stored as fixture.enc.json, is routed to Json. Official SOPS3.10.0 successfully returns a JSON object with the binary value escaped as a string, rather than the binary bytes. The production NUL refusal no longer sees a NUL, and the displayed comparison represents the wrong decoded format. The same issue changes UTF-8 binary-file presentation.
findings.evidence: review-evidence/sops_format_check.py is an independently preserved env-cleared, private HOME/XDG, generated-age-key fixture. It directly checks official fixed input/output-store behavior; production recognition dispatch is established statically at the cited lines. No independent application compilation or newly compiled production reproduction is claimed.
findings.required_fix: Handle JSON/binary store ambiguity explicitly instead of silently using extension plus object-key count as an authoritative format. Preserve correct structured JSON for a single data field and preserve actual binary output validation for binary envelopes, including .json names. An explicit per-view format choice or safe ambiguity refusal with a useful choice is acceptable.
required_regressions: Real generated-age structured JSON {data:42} at extensionless/.yaml paths compares successfully as JSON.
Real generated-age binary UTF-8 envelope named .json displays actual text through Binary mode.
Real generated-age binary NUL/non-UTF8 envelope named .json is refused by binary-output validation.
A rename across extensions preserves or explicitly resolves chosen formats for both exact compared versions.

independent_checks.compile: NONE; frozen author binary reused read-only
independent_checks.selected_result: 20 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored, 793 filtered; real official SOPS3.10.0 and age-keygen1.2.1 fixture executed with generated offline keys

accepted_observations: Decryption requires explicit UI action; ordinary recognition reads ciphertext and invokes no SOPS.
The production tool boundary accepts only fixed format values and ciphertext; SOPS always runs on the UI machine from a neutral directory, including SSH/WSL repository sources.

Private worker/result channels belong to the view and do not enter shared Msg/DiffData/settings/activity. Current tests cover close/drop/request changes, late results, input revalidation and initiating profile context.
Inactive tabs discard decrypted state; profile switching drops/reconstructs tabs; refresh, mode changes and operation starts discard it. Existing raw Git ciphertext transport remains Practice aware.
Decrypted display disables normal selection/copy/comment/staging paths; queued partial writes also reject an enabled private view. Git patch requests add --no-textconv.
Raw tool stderr/errors are suppressed, capped and generalized; stdout is capped and validated for UTF-8/NUL/line limits. Tests cover cancellation of owned local children and output limits.
Private galley layout bypasses egui shared GalleyCache; independently executed test confirms unchanged cache count.
No new production remote runner, PID selector, signal controller or process-control architecture is introduced. Existing approved bounded-process production code is unchanged by this feature.
limits: No fresh independent Cargo compile; read-only author binary binding relies on supplied checked source/compile records.
No live SSH/WSL, Windows, external account, user keys, or credential environment used.
The format edge fixture uses official CLI stores directly; the app's private recognizer dispatch was inspected statically.
This scoped review does not replace exact final combined tests and independent whole-combination review.
release_decision: Fix SOPS-CORRECTNESS-1 and re-review the immutable pushed candidate before feature acceptance. No merge/PR approval.
